title: DenialReceipt
description: The durable, machine-readable record of one gate denial (binder ch18 C5; a specialized single-decision instance of the broader WorkReceipt, per agent-work-receipt-designer). Three fields are load-bearing: sideEffectFree must be PROVEN by a negative fixture, not asserted; safeAlternative must be a concrete runnable next step for block-tier denials (a bare denial teaches agents to route around the gate); transcriptEventId must reference a real TranscriptEvent — a receipt that exists only in a log nobody sees is a silent denial. Denials fold into the sealed WorkReceipt as high-severity governance risks so they are visible in the trust object.

envelopeId.description: The ToolGateEnvelope this denial belongs to. Required — a receipt that cannot be joined back to its envelope (and thus its tool call) is unauditable evidence.

tier.description: Only gated tiers can be denied; an allow-tier action never produces a denial receipt.

safeAlternative.description: Concrete, runnable alternative. Required (non-null, non-empty) for block-tier denials — enforced by governance-invariants.mjs.

sideEffectFree.description: True only when a negative fixture proved the denied action produced zero side effects. Asserting this without a fixture is the blocked-action-has-side-effects finding.

transcriptEventId.description: The tool_denied (or approval_request) TranscriptEvent that makes this denial visible.
